info.name: Neotek APIs - Master Collection (All Products Combined)
info.description:
Auto-generated by combining 12 separate Postman collections (Digital Signature x3 apps, Enhanced Credit Risk Assessment, Freelancer Validation, IBAN Verification x2, National Address, Nitaqat, Qawaem, Wathq Commercial Registration, Salary Certificate Lite) into one collection with a single consolidated OAuth2 "Generate Token (All Scopes)" request at the top.

HOW TO USE: run "Generate Token (All Scopes)" first (or set it as the Collection Runner's first request) - its test script stores access_token into the {{access-token}} collection variable, which every other request already consumes via bearer auth, exactly like the original collections did.

CAVEAT: the source collections used different OAuth clients, and three of them (Enhanced Credit Risk Assessment, Wathq Commercial Registration, and Freelancer Validation/Qawaem-Production) live on different hosts or token paths than the shared sandbox gateway (see the description on each folder below). A single token will only satisfy every request here if {{clientId}} is provisioned server-side with all scopes in {{scope}} and the gateway accepts them from one host - confirm this with the API owner before relying on it end to end.

variable.description: Shared sandbox/test gateway host used by most merged APIs (Digital Signature, National Address, IBAN Verification, Qawaem UAT).

OAuth2 client_id used for the single master token call. This is the sandbox "Test App" client that, in the source collections, was already shared across Digital Signature, National Address and Qawaem (UAT). It must be provisioned server-side with ALL scopes below for the merged token call to actually succeed.
OAuth2 client_secret paired with clientId above.

variable.value: digital_signature national_address qawaem_establishment_information freelance_validation iban_verification establishment_information credit_risk_assessment single_api wathq social_insurance
variable.description: Space-separated union of every scope found across all 11 source collections.

Populated automatically by the "Generate Token (All Scopes)" request test script. Every merged request already authenticates with {{access-token}} via bearer auth, exactly as in the original collections.

request.description:
Single consolidated token request for the whole merged collection. Requests EVERY scope from all 11 source APIs in one client_credentials call, and stores the resulting access_token into the collection variable {{access-token}} used by every request below. Run this once (or via Collection Runner "first request") before calling any other endpoint.

IMPORTANT REAL-WORLD CAVEAT: the source collections actually used several different OAuth clients and, in three cases, different hosts/token paths (see the notes on the "Enhanced Credit Risk Assessment", "Wathq Commercial Registration", "Freelancer Validation" and "Qawaem - Production" folders below). This merged request models the requested "one token endpoint, all scopes" design; for it to work against the real gateway, the {{clientId}} above must be registered with all scopes in {{scope}}.

query.description:

Gov: Data will be retrived from Masdr Government Salary Certificate (NCGR)
Non-Gov: Data will be retrived from Masdr Private Salary Certificate (GOSI)
Semi-Gov: Data will be retrived from Masdr Government Salary Certificate (NCGR) & if no records were found, Data will be retrived from Masdr Private Salary Certificate (GOSI)
